flaws.description: The unsubscribe endpoint takes a sequential integer id with no signed token, so anyone can unsubscribe every user by enumerating ids
last_run_at and sent_at are only advanced after the whole batch, so a crash, timeout or Resend error mid-loop re-sends every earlier email on the next run

flaws.description: The alert history query filters notifications by user_id and sent_at with no index; the table grows by thousands of rows per day
User email addresses and search parameters are written to console logs and Sentry breadcrumbs, leaking PII into third-party log storage

Preferences.tsx is a client component that instantiates Resend with RESEND_API_KEY, which either ships the secret to the browser or silently fails since non-NEXT_PUBLIC env vars are undefined on the client
The plan reuses src/emails/SavedSearchDigest.tsx as already existing, but the file inventory in the plan shows no src/emails directory
